scenario: [LTSL.7.3]: "the compiler must reject a reply of any other schema". Library `lib` declares `HeaterAck`, which `heater.on` answers with, and `Other`, and this file binds `Other` under the name `HeaterAck`. A stub replying `HeaterAck` therefore replies a fact of `Other`, with the spelling of the response. Refused with DS_VALIDATE_TEST_STUB_REPLY_TYPE. A comparison of spellings admits it. PATH PINNED: `dsc.dstest.reply_of`, as its pair `LTSL.7.3_a_reply_through_an_alias_is_admitted`.
rules_ds:
from lib import Other as HeaterAck

schema Reading scope logical:
    zone: String key
    celsius: Float mutable

rule cold:
    Reading r where r.celsius < 5.0
->
    call heater.on zone: r.zone nocooldown as "h1"

test "reply":
    inputs:
        at 0_s:
            Reading zone: "a" celsius: 1.0
    responses:
        for call heater.on as "h1":
            HeaterAck ok: true
    produces:
        called heater.on as "h1"

libraries.lib:
schema HeaterAck scope ttl 1_min:
    corr: String
    ok: Bool

schema Other scope ttl 1_min:
    corr: String
    ok: Bool

service heater.on:
    kwarg zone: String
    response HeaterAck
